rendered_pages._comment: outside_reach ADDS to the pack's own four (.git, .claude, .live-spec, attic); it never replaces them (SPEC R296.12, R296.13).

row.targets_source: the one accepted task's own recorded acceptance command in scripts/plan_checks.py (CHECKS[<task id>]); no check outside that one task runs

integration.targets_comment: the NAMED test targets this integration run covers, written here before it starts and resolved from the layers the change touched; empty until a change names them, and an integration run with none is refused. No count stands in for naming them: a cap admitted any five targets and refused a sixth for no stateable reason (2026-09-08).
integration.targets_source: only the layers a change touched, each resolved through this mode's own layer_map to its own named test targets; the selection reads which layers the diff touched, never the size of the corpus or the count of rows on the board
integration.layer_map_comment: layer name -> list of NAMED test targets; empty until a change names a layer, never filled with an invented figure

release.core_version_source: VERSION at the time this list was taken from .github/workflows/gates.yml
